[[File:The Hushed Bank.jpg|thumb|300px|The Hushed Bank.]]

'''The Hushed Bank''' is the stretch of [[Duskwood]] along the western river. It runs from where the river forks and the three corners of [[Westfall]], [[Elwynn Forest]], and Duskwood meet south to [[Stranglethorn Vale]]. The covered bridge connecting Duskwood and Westfall is also located on the Hushed Bank. [[Lars]] and [[Sven Yorgen]] could be found on the northern corner of the Hushed Bank. It was also inhabited by spiders and wolves.
